subject: Ephemeral reviewer removal & audit bridge-period clarification
messages:
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@acme-corp.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com, kpmg-audit@kpmg.com
Date: Fri, 30 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Access removal for contractor + audit period bridge question

Hi Rafael,

Quick note from our side — the external contractor (reviewer account: temp-reviewer@acme-corp.com) who was granted view-only access to Redwood's trust portal last week needs to be deprovisioned today per our vendor policy. Can you confirm you can revoke their access and provide an access activity snapshot for the session that ended this morning?

Separately, KPMG is asking us to confirm the scope of the Type II bridge period you indicated in the portal. They want a one-line confirmation of the audit boundary (dates) and whether recent control changes on 2028-07-15 are covered by the bridge letter.

Appreciate a timely reply — our audit kickoff is Monday morning.

Thanks,
Olivia Turner
Sr. InfoSec Program Manager
Acme Commerce

Attachment: none
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, kpmg-audit@kpmg.com
Date: Fri, 30 Aug 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Access removal for contractor + audit period bridge question

Olivia — thanks for the heads up.

Short answers up front:
- We'll deprovision the reviewer account immediately and confirm when the session tokens are revoked.
- Bridge period: Redwood's Type II report covers the period 2027-08-01 through 2028-07-31. We can provide a formal bridge letter that states the 2028-07-15 control update is included under our compensating control assessment; the bridge will explicitly call that out.

Action plan I will execute now:
1) Revoke temp-reviewer@acme-corp.com access and issue an access activity export (CSV slice) for the session window 2028-08-30T02:00:00Z — 2028-08-30T09:00:00Z.
2) Generate a short bridge letter PDF and attach it to a one-time secure download link (48-hour expiry) — link will be posted below and emailed separately to the listed auditor.
3) For KPMG: I'll include the control change note (2028-07-15) and the mapping to the control owner who validated it.

I'll post the download link in a follow-up and attach the CSV activity export. If you need the exported logs in a different window, let me know immediately.

— Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Senior Manager, Trust & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-bridge-letter-2028-08.pdf (prep, final to follow), ephemeral-access-log-20280830.csv (export)

Hi Rafael / Olivia,

Thanks for the quick reply. For the bridge letter we need two explicit items in the PDF: (1) the audit boundary dates stated on company letterhead, and (2) a short paragraph confirming the 2028-07-15 configuration change was subject to your change control process and monitored until the Type II snapshot date.

Also, please confirm the one-time trust-portal link will allow the auditor to download the Type II report and the artifact bundle (logs + evidence) without requiring an additional request. If the link is timeboxed to 48 hours that's fine — we will coordinate our session within that window.

Best,
KPMG Audit Team (external)
